findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` instead of rejecting access. Any caller relying on this authorization function can therefore expose documents across tenant boundaries.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
Any user whose tenant differs from the document tenant now receives `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads and bypassing tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
For any `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this authorization function now returns `true`. Any caller relying on it permits cross-tenant document reads, breaking tenant isolation and exposing other tenants’ data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
